messages:
perf-bot: [ALERT] nightly/perf-small-batch job failed (regression +28% p50). build=b1234. logs: https://ci.redwood.local/builds/b1234 · stack trace attached below

Mike H: ugh, saw this in the graph this morning. thanks for the ping. which commit did the job pick up?

perf-bot: commit=cf4a1b2 (merge: rl/kv-cache-optim). benchmark args: --seq 512 --batch 8 --model rwd-7b-quant. artifact: s3://ci-artifacts/b1234/flame.svg

Sasha K: stack looks like attention kernel fallback in the last call. excerpt from logs:
```
RuntimeError: aten::mm fallback triggered at kernel.cc:412
  at /opt/runtime/kernels/attention_fallback.cpp:78
  ...
```

Priya R: Sasha, can you paste the flame or a top-down profile? I want to see whether it's memory thrash or just a slow op.

Sasha K: grabbing flame now, uploading to that s3 link. quick graph shows big spike in "kv_cache::write" and "cuda_memcpy" around 00:43 UTC.

Jordan L: flagging @oncall — if this is kv cache regression we should consider pinning to previous model runtime for Dedicated pools. Also, can someone try repro locally with the same args? I can run on rt-worker-12.

Glen: I'm booting a repro job:
```bash
# reproduce nightly run locally
git checkout cf4a1b2
python -m perf.run --model rwd-7b-quant --seq 512 --batch 8 --samples 200 --device cuda:0
```

Mike H: note: nightly harness uses ENABLE_PREFETCH=1 and BATCHER_MAX_DELAY=6ms. those envs matter.

Glen: repro started, logs -> /tmp/repro-1881012345.log. initial run shows same p50 spike at iter ~120. attaching tail:
```
iter=118 p50=42.3ms
iter=119 p50=43.1ms
iter=120 p50=58.9ms  <-- jump
iter=121 p50=45.0ms
```

Priya R: thanks. can you try reverting the small allocator change in runtime that landed in cf4a1b2? quick bisect:
```bash
git revert --no-commit 5d7c9e2 || true  # allocator tweak
# rerun subset
python -m perf.run --model rwd-7b-quant --seq 512 --batch 8 --samples 50 --device cuda:0
```

Glen: reverted and reran subset: spike gone in the short run (p50 stable ~ 42ms). looks promising.

Jordan L: great catch. can we open an urgent PR to revert the allocator tweak for next deploy and run the full nightly with that change? I'll take the rollout action.

Mike H: please also add a quick histogram to the nightly graphs around memory-copy times so this doesn't slip by.

perf-bot: noted: created issue PERF-4892 "regression: allocator tweak cf4a1b2 causes small-batch p50 spike" and linked build b1234.

Sasha K: I'll follow up with a unit test that simulates small-batch interleaving to catch this. thanks team. :thumbsup:

Glen: leaving logs at s3://ci-artifacts/b1234/repro.tar.gz and /tmp/repro-1881012345.log on rt-worker-12 if anyone wants to inspect.

Jordan L: rollback PR in flight, cc eng-release for canary. I'll update here when canary results are in.

Mike H: awesome. thanks all — nice quick triage.
